title: Full Moon
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Twelve-year-old Mitsuki dreams of singing to reach her first love, Eichi, but a throat tumor threatens her voice and her grandmother forbids music. Two shinigami, Takuto and Meroko, tell her she has a year to live; Takuto lets her transform into a healthy sixteen-year-old so she can debut as the singer Full Moon. Mitsuki learns the shinigami were once people who died by suicide, faces Eichi's death, and chooses surgery and life.
life_message: Life is precious and worth fighting for; grief and love can coexist, and dreams are pursued by choosing to live.

folkways.japan: Shinigami (death gods) and souls lingering through attachment draw on Japanese Buddhist and folk ideas of the dead.

delivery.evidence: Wikipedia plot: Takuto helps Mitsuki realize she must live fully; suicide's regret is told through each shinigami's backstory.

delivery.note: Characters who oppose Mitsuki are given painful backstories and reconcile, rather than being cast as simply wrong.

winners_losers: Mitsuki lives, sings and reunites with Takuto; despair and suicide are shown as losses, and even antagonists find peace.
